summary: Phase 2 frontend test — Parts Catalogue + 6-step Bulk Import wizard (CSV upload → AI mapping → validate → review → commit → done). Tested end-to-end as admin@gymaxisai.com. ALL 5 features pass.

issues: Cookie banner sits at bottom-right and partially overlaps the last list row in 1280×900 viewport. Wizard modal is z-[120] (above banner) so no functional impact, but the banner can briefly cover the last catalogue card. Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: PartsCatalogue.js l.40 — `importing` state name shadows industry-meaning (consider `importOpen`). Cosmetic.

PartsImportWizard.js l.66 — Mapping validation only checks `sku` + `name` client-side. Backend rejects but UX could disable Validate button when those are unmapped (currently relies on toast). Minor UX nit.

PartsImportWizard.js — `useAi` toggle label has the checkbox INSIDE a <label data-testid="import-ai-toggle">; this is functionally fine but a Playwright click on `import-ai-toggle` would toggle the checkbox via label-for behaviour. Works as-is.
PartsCatalogue.js l.50 — `catch { notify.error('Could not load catalogue') }` swallows the underlying error message; consider surfacing `e?.response?.data?.detail` for easier debugging in prod.
